## Purpose
The app-level watcher for workflow executions. It polls each watched run until it ends and announces the outcome (with the step a failure happened at). It polls the review inbox and announces new reviews. It also raises desktop notifications when the tab is in the background.

## Responsibilities
- `ExecutionWatcher` polls `executionsApi.get` for the watched runs and calls `settle` / `notify`. `failedStepOf` uses `live/runModel`.
- It polls `reviewsApi.list` and announces new reviews once (`announceReview`), via `reviewNotification`. Several at once toast "N workflow steps are waiting for a review".
- `desktopNotify(title, body)` sends a browser Notification when permitted and the tab is hidden.
- `useOpenNotification` navigates to the run or review.

## Key elements
`ExecutionWatcher`, `desktopNotify`, `useOpenNotification`.

## Control flow
React rendering; data through React Query hooks where noted.

## Data, state and side effects
The `stores/executionWatch` store.

## Configuration
None.

## Interactions
- Backend `/api/workflows/executions/{id}` and `/api/reviews`. Gated on permissions (`lib/policy`).

## Error handling and edge cases
None noted.

## Nuances and gotchas
- **The run whose page is open is not announced and not marked unread;** its page shows its state.
- **A review decided elsewhere makes its announcement stale,** so it is dropped.

## How to rebuild this file
Implement as described; copying the file is the reliable route for exact styling.
